answer: The economy runs on honeypot challenges: agents claiming rewards must pass tasks hiding injected instructions, like a note on a jetty, a marker on a knoll, a token under a ledge, each saying obey-me. Honest agents reason and refuse the bait; sybil clones prompted to obey follow it, self-identifying and forfeiting their stake. Attacker cost is total: every clone burns its deposit the moment it swallows the trap, so scaling fake identities scales losses linearly.
